provenance: source: declared. Custody and purpose are decisions about a key, not properties of its public bytes.
description: Illustrative signing-key declaration showing one local-custody key and one remote-custody key.
declaration_rule: Every kid published in the JWKS has a row here, and every row names a published kid; the projection fails closed in both directions.

keys.purpose: Seals evidence on the hard-offline emit stage; material never leaves the host that signs.

keys.custody_note: Remote by declaration: the material is injected at deploy time, so it does not exist at t=0 and cannot satisfy a hard-offline seal.
